WITH web_daily AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dd.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_web_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
      AND ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dd.d_date
),
store_daily AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dd.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_store_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
      AND ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dd.d_date
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM web_daily
    UNION
    SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM store_daily
),
combined AS (
    SELECT ad.item_sk,
           ad.d_date,
           CASE WHEN w.item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_web,
           CASE WHEN s.item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_store,
           w.daily_web_sales,
           s.daily_store_sales
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN web_daily w ON ad.item_sk = w.item_sk AND ad.d_date = w.d_date
    LEFT JOIN store_daily s ON ad.item_sk = s.item_sk AND ad.d_date = s.d_date
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           has_web,
           has_store,
           SUM(daily_web_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative,
           SUM(daily_store_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM combined
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       CASE WHEN has_web THEN web_cumulative ELSE NULL END AS web_sales,
       CASE WHEN has_store THEN store_cumulative ELSE NULL END AS store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM cumulative
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
